typed_failure: With no auxiliary ledger visible, all four records placed sentence aliases into auxiliary_observation_ids; those IDs were correctly rejected as unknown.

semantic_review.comparison: The ledger-backed chronological v3 reader recovered the named-role alternative but not its minority limit. The conversation-only reader recovered neither. Omitting the ledger did not improve the protected failure.

decision.next_architecture_question: Design an exploration-only local chronological harvesting path that preserves alternative-plus-attached-limit pairs without a fresh global synthesizer, while leaving the four passing full-conversation views unchanged.

nonclaims: One ablation does not prove auxiliary ledgers are always beneficial or harmless.
The result rejects this full-conversation exploration reader, not probabilistic semantic interpretation or the hybrid architecture.
